title: Search List continuation must survive authorization filtering
answers: When must listWithSelectors emit a NextPageToken?
What decides whether a search List page needs a continuation token?
Rules for continuing search-backed list pagination
body:
Any change to listWithSelectors's page-building logic must keep emitting a continuation token whenever rowCount >= req.Limit OR the search response's total hit count is inexact (searchResp.GetTotalHitsExact() == false) — authorization can shrink a full page or stop before filling one, and an inexact total can't rule out more matches.
Enforced in pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go:searchListNeedsContinue, called from listWithSelectors after authorization filtering completes.
The continue token must be built from the last surviving row's sortFields (not the pre-filter last row) and must carry forward the original listRv used for this List call, not the resource version from the current search response.
If skipped, clients treat a filtered-short page as the final page and silently miss later authorized resources; if the RV isn't preserved, subsequent pages could be read against an inconsistent resource version.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go — any future edits to authorization filtering, batching, or pagination logic in search-backed List
